name: Mikazuki Megu
source:
Nekomata. Known as “Meg” in her cat form.

Originally a stray cat, she acquired supernatural powers and gained the ability to transform into human form.

Though never formally kept as a pet, she called Minako “Grandma” and spent most of her time at her house. She learned most human common sense from Minako. (The rest she picked up from dramas, anime, and manga.)

She possesses enough human skills to live independently, but her cat nature occasionally surfaces.  She can cook, but even in human form, her taste buds lean cat-like.

She became attached to Hibiki when she arrived at the house and started accompanying her everywhere. (Hibiki's shoulder is her favorite spot.)

Her personality is calm and laid-back; she's the type who doesn't sweat the small stuff. She absolutely loves sleeping and usually naps in her usual spot.

She can attack demons with her claws, which are imbued with her supernatural power.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_BlackCat/]official site[/url]]
